glosses: meervoud van het zelfstandig naamwoord bluts
To strike (a person), originally with something flat or heavy, but now specifically in such a way as to discolour the skin without breaking it; to contuse.

examples.text: It is as I have spoken: the testing first, next the bruising, and in the last bout the breaking and killing.

glosses: To damage the skin of (fruit or vegetables), in an analogous way.
Of fruit or vegetables, to gain bruises through being handled roughly.
To fight with the fists; to box.

examples.text: Bruising was considered a fine, manly, old English custom.

glosses: To harm or injure somebody's feelings or self-esteem.

examples.text: Her thoughtless remarks bruised my ego.
I was bruised by such wanton criticism.

glosses: To impair (gin) by shaking rather than stirring.
A purplish mark on the skin due to leakage of blood from capillaries under the surface that have been damaged by a blow.
A dark mark on fruit or vegetables caused by a blow to the surface.
Causar lesión, contusión o hematoma a un tejido orgánico, por golpe, succión u otra razón, sin que este llegue a sangrar exteriormente.
